presentation_differences: The review draft reports only deterministic age and legacy candidate-row count; it deliberately suppresses vaccine rows, status labels, alerts, catch-up advice, and contraindication claims.
All eight named condition checkboxes are retained; the legacy pneumococcal risk flag is derived from asthma, diabetes and heart disease. Schedule recommendations remain suppressed.
logic_differences: The legacy country selector did not alter its hard-coded schedule, risk-category immunocompromise was not connected to condition checks, prior dose history was absent, and future birth dates were not rejected.
The unversioned CDC/WHO-style schedule and wall-clock seasonal assumptions are not migrated as clinical recommendations.
unresolved_clinical_ambiguities: A designated immunization-program clinical owner must provide authoritative jurisdiction-specific schedules with source URL, edition, effective date, review date, revision policy, age/dose rules, prior-dose history, catch-up logic, contraindications, and risk-population rules.
Engineering must then introduce a typed versioned schedule resource and deterministic row renderer before publication.
reviewer_decision: Blocked pending an authoritative schedule and independent immunization-clinician approval. Do not approve or publish this review draft.
